en: <CLT=cltMIND>He finally came back...

Ughhh! There are bugs everywhere!
How nast—I mean, how nice!

Oh, you come back, Kokichi!
Come, we have fun!
We gonna have so much fun!

Y'know, as much as I'd *love* to do that...
maybe we should call it a day, hm?

The bugs look really tired, and a gentleman
knows to do things in moderation, y'know?
Oh...Gonta understand...

So you clean up while I take care of business
with the others.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi's hands were full of
several Kubs Pads.

Well? Everyone have fun time meeting
and greeting the bugs?
Ah...y-yeah, I suppose I did...?
Good! Now everyone like bugs!

More bugs hatching real soon! Let's have
fun time meeting and greeting new bugs!

More bugs hatching real soon! Let's have
fun time meeting and greeting new bugs!

You guys okay? You all look like drowned
sewer rats.
Cuz you're late!

You said you'd be back by nighttime,
but it's already 11 p.m. now.
Sorry, I ran into an unexpected snafu.
But, look.

Kubs Pads! Gotta catch 'em all! I even got the
pads belonging to the people who aren't here!

Nee-heehee... Now everyone can watch their
<CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
We said we don't want to.

Well, it's late and I'm getting sleepy!
So let's start already.
...Start what?

Oh, don't worry about it, Gonta. Just keep
watch so these guys don't—
That's it! I won't let you do as you please!
Hm?

I didn't want to use this unless I absolutely
had to. It eats up a lot of my electricity.

But that's neither here nor there!
I will stop you right here, right now!
Keebo...what are you going to do...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Still glaring at Kokichi, Keebo slowly
reached a hand behind his ear...
<CLT=cltMIND>and spun the mechanical parts there.

He's lighting up!?
Is he gonna self-destruct or—
<CLT=cltMIND>*whirrr...*
Huh? What's that sound?

One moment please...
I'm rewinding the tape right now.
The tape?
Riiiight...there!

<CLT=cltMIND>Keebo shouted out and pushed
his palm against his ear.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's when...

Is this your doing, Kokichi?
Did you have Gonta kidnap us?
<CLT=cltMIND>Was that...my voice?
Nee-heehee...he's so simple-minded.

As soon as I told him that everyone who
hates bugs was trying to get rid of them...

...he started crying, and said that he would get
you guys to love bugs...or something like that.
Could this be...?

So, what do you think!? You just saw my
<CLT=cltSTRONG>audio recording<CLT=cltNORMAL> function for the first time!

Did he really just whip out an audio recorder
like it's some kinda secret weapon!?

Really? It's a cassette tape?
In this day and age?
But it's metal tape, you know!?
The sound quality isn't the issue!

L-Let's just put this aside now.
More importantly, it seems to have worked.

Kokichi...what you mean?
You...not like bugs?
...Maaan, now it's boring.

You say we get them to understand how
amazing bugs are... Was that lie?

Haha, I wouldn't lie to you. I loooove bugs.
From the bottom of my heart.

Oh... So it not a lie. Then Gonta happy...
Let's have fun with bugs all night...
Who want to pet more bugs!?
Eh?
We must run while we still can!

Wait! We need to take back our Kubs Pads
first!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tenko snatched the Kubs Pads
from Kokichi.
Awwww...
<CLT=cltMIND>Then, we all ran out of the lab.

And so...we have escaped from the maw 
of hell itself, somehow...

...Thank you for enduring it, everyone.
This is the last chance.
Please leave the rest to me.

Nyeh? What's going on? The last thing I 
remember is Gonta releasing the bugs...

<CLT=cltMIND>Did she pass out from fear...?
Welp, I can understand that.
I-I'm still okay!

As a disciple of Neo-Aikido, it'll take more
than this to break my composure!
Ah, Tenko! There's a big ol' bug on your back!
GAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!
C-Calm down, Tenko!
<CLT=cltMIND>I frantically swatted the bug off her.

I-It's okay, there were bugs everywhere,
it's no wonder you—
I-I don't need help from some male!
Clearly, I haven't trained enough...

As soon as I escape from this place, I will
return to Master and resume my training!
Clearly, I haven't trained enough...

As soon as I escape from this place, I will
return to Master and resume my training!

Aww... So he really did go get 
the Kubs Pads...
Nyahahaha! What a divine time!

My island is full of creepy crawlers.
This many bugs doesn't bug me.

Shuichi, where are you going?
The main event is about to start.
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's so clunky...
I wonder if that's just what Monokuma likes.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is just a specimen...
I know it's dead, but...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>They're even in the books!
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to see another bug
for a very long time...

Shuichi, where are you going?
The main event is about to start.
